operation.summary: Agent activity from the phone's log, with the same redaction as remote view: no messages, parameters or results. Oldest first after since; the newest page without it. For the owner's Bridgit app on iPhone & iPad, over the relay; read-only.

query.name: client
query.description: Optional: the viewing device, e.g. iPhone, iPad or Android (1-24 letters, digits, space . _ -). The phone's Home shows it as the device viewing it

query.name: since
query.description: Log id: only entries after it (use next_since from the last page)

query.name: until
query.description: Log id: an older page, entries before it (use oldest_id); not with since

operation.returns: entries[{id, ts, agent, kind, method, path, status, caption, plus the Home scene keys channel, level, result, endpoint, http, message, params, data}], next_since (pass back as since; it moves past skipped entries too), has_more, has_older, oldest_id (pass as until for the next older page), latest_id

client.description: Optional: the viewing device, e.g. iPhone, iPad or Android (1-24 letters, digits, space . _ -). The phone's Home shows it as the device viewing it

until.description: Log id: an older page, entries before it (use oldest_id); not with since

since.description: Log id: only entries after it (use next_since from the last page)
